decisions.reason: As a distributor's catalog item with its own page, the cutting and creasing finisher costs little to keep listed while its demand is still uncertain only one year after launch.

The UV spot varnishing system had its German premiere at a customer event and is featured on the home page, so it signals strong commitment and its value is still unfolding, making abandonment premature.
The sheet preparation module is a low-cost listing from a supplier partner with uncertain but unresolved prospects, so keeping the option open is cheap.
The B2 multifinisher was promoted on the home page as a new solution and positions the firm in a growing format, so further results are worth waiting for.
The hybrid saddle stitcher costs little to keep in the portfolio and has had too little time on the market to show that its value will not be realized.
The folding add-on already has a documented customer installation, which is a positive signal that justifies keeping it as a complement to the Touchline line.
